answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the horizon check immediately, the willow audit keeps the resolved set and the onyx replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 259 aliases therefore forfeits the reading cost 259 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
